title: StateChange type duplicated between ws/mod.rs and sse.rs
description: ws/mod.rs defines a StateChange struct with changed: HashMap<String, HashMap<String, String>>; sse.rs defines SseEvent::StateChange { changed: HashMap<String, HashMap<String, String>> } with the same field type. The payload type is identical but defined twice. A shared StateChange type (in jmap-types or exported from one module) would eliminate the duplication and let callers handle state-change data from both SSE and WebSocket paths uniformly.
